summary: Taiga is an agile project management tool designed to help teams plan and track work using Kanban and Scrum methodologies. It provides a structured interface for organising tasks, managing backlogs, and monitoring progress throughout development lifecycles. The platform is self-hosted using Docker, Python, and Node.js components.
goodFor: Development teams who want a dedicated, self-hosted workspace specifically tailored to Scrum and Kanban workflows.
watchOut: Because release and commit activity metrics are currently unavailable, you should carefully evaluate its stability and long-term maintenance status before depending on it in production.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for user data and attach a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for the web containers.
